name: GL-NeRF
definition: A training-free acceleration method for volume rendering in NeRF models that uses Gauss-Laguerre quadrature to reduce the number of MLP calls, introducing no additional data structures or neural networks.
summary: GL-NeRF is a training-free NeRF acceleration method that reduces neural network calls by replacing stochastic sampling with deterministic point selection based on Gauss-Laguerre quadrature.
